I replied to Pree in her DM to confirm I'll remember this: Tamsyn Tolland is now her go-to contact at Tansley Parcel for escalations on the Driftwood rollout.

The brain had already saved her message automatically, and only she can see it. I checked that it's there with a brain search. I didn't save a second copy with `remember`, because I couldn't tell how visible that copy would be, and it might have exposed her DM to other people.
